# technitium_app (Resource)

Installs a DNS app from a download URL, such as one from the DNS App Store. Changing the URL updates the app in place; destroying the resource uninstalls it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_app" "split_horizon" {
  name = "Split Horizon"
  url  = "https://download.technitium.com/dns/apps/SplitHorizonApp-v11.zip"
}

# url is optional: leave it out to adopt an app that is already installed, and
# set it later to install or update the app from that URL.
resource "technitium_app" "adopted" {
  name = "Advanced Blocking"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The app name, for example `Split Horizon`. Changing it replaces the app, which needs `url` to install the new one.

### Optional

- `url` (String) The `https://` URL of the app's zip file, for example `https://download.technitium.com/dns/apps/SplitHorizonApp-v11.zip`. Needed to install the app; an imported app may leave it out, and setting or changing it updates the app from that URL. The server does not return it, so an app updated outside Terraform is seen through `version`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `update_available` (Boolean) Whether the DNS App Store has a newer version.
- `update_version` (String) The newest version in the DNS App Store.
- `version` (String) The installed version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_app.split_horizon "Split Horizon"
```
